messages:
jordan: Kicking off a targeted access tidy for KMS admin bindings this quarter. Goal: remove or tighten any cross-account admin roles/grants that lack clear ownership.
nina: 👍 can you clarify scope? all accounts or just prod-ish ones?
jordan: start with prod, staging, and analytics. focus on: 1) roles that can `kms:*` 2) keys with external grants 3) roles without `maintainer` or `owner` tags.
carlos: i can run the inventory. will filter for policies containing "kms:" and any principals outside `redwood.com`.
techbot: Inventory results ready: 88 roles with broad KMS permissions, 34 keys with cross-account grants (8 external orgs), 20 roles missing maintainer tag. Report: https://internal/reports/kms-access-qtr2.csv
emily: proposal: three-stage approach — (A) owner discovery + 72h notice, (B) soft restriction (deny kms:CreateGrant & kms:ReEncrypt) for 7d, (C) removal after 21d if no response. keep a dry-run mode in step B for the first batch.
jordan: agree. also require that any maintainer tag include an email and an expiration YYYY-MM-DD tag if the binding is temporary.
nina: for cross-account principals, we should classify as: internal-account, partner, external-org. which ones are partner vs external?
carlos: partner list maintained in infra-systems under `partners.yml`. i'll reconcile and mark partner-grants as medium priority. external-org grants -> high priority.
techbot: To find roles missing tags:
```
aws iam list-roles --query "Roles[?contains(RoleName, 'prod') && !Tags[?Key=='maintainer']].RoleName" --output json
```
opsbot: automation note: `decommission-notify@redwood` will send initial owner discovery messages. After 72h, a ticket is auto-filed to SECURITY-Triage if no owner.
emily: audit hook addition: create an alert when an external principal performs kms:Decrypt on prod key after we start the canary. Wire low-priority alert to #eng-security and high-priority to oncall.
jordan: add retention note: keep full KMS Audit logs for 400d for these keys during the project.
nina: runbook asks whether to prefer key-policy tightening vs role removal. my vote: tighten key policy first if the key has a clear sponsor team. if not, remove roles.
carlos: action items: 1) produce CSV with columns: role, role_arn, tags, last_used, trusted_entities, linked_keys 2) flag external principals 3) identify keys with grants created in last 180d. ETA 6h.
emily: i'll draft the owner discovery message and the soft restriction notice templates. will include the dry-run toggle.
jordan: cool. timeline: inventory & classification today, owner discovery tomorrow, soft restrictions next Tue (canary), full removal 21d after notification if unresolved.
techbot: sample audit query to validate Decrypt usage: 
```
SELECT ts, principal, action, resource
FROM audit_events
WHERE service='kms' AND action='Decrypt' AND resource.account IN ('prod','staging','analytics')
  AND ts > ago(180d)
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 200
```
nina: i'll review the partners list and hand off partner exceptions to legal for review where needed.
jordan: final ask: anyone who can't meet the 6h CSV ETA ping me directly. we'll prioritize the external-org cases first. thanks all. :lock:
